items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: Sam used to come down and talk with him sometime. He borrowed that handbook from my dad

ctx.x: numbers out of that. Your daddy was a Christian then?

Oh yes. Yeah, my daddy gave up music, but he knew it's Sam. Sam used to come down and talk with him sometime. He borrowed that handbook from my dad and that's why he got that number from over in the glory lane, out that book. I think the name of the book was the Victory Handbook. Now I looked at that
book last night. Yeah, well we'd like to see that one. Yeah, I'd like to see the hymns. Those are wonderful.
